title: Parameters persist; activations belong to a call
purpose: Separate shared model weights, borrowed inputs and independent output lifetimes.
contract: Q/K/V own independent Vec payloads; head views borrow those outputs.
into_parts transfers ownership without copying payload; no KV cache exists yet.
